svg.title: BR1 Tour Route Optimization — Architecture
svg.desc: Layered data-flow diagram of the BR1 tour route pipeline, contrasting a Spark data lake of Parquet files with a ClickHouse data warehouse that serves the tourist map and Grafana.
svg.text: Data Lake (files, schema-on-read, Spark) vs Data Warehouse (ClickHouse, schema-on-write, serving)
Data Lake zone colour = files / Spark
Data Warehouse zone colour = database / queries
Schema-on-read: Spark interprets at query time
